d:
Ahead of the INDIA bloc rally in Delhi, several photos and videos went viral on social media. Claims suggested that railway stations were witnessing a massive rush of passengers, Kareena Kapoor had appealed to people to attend the rally, and The Indian Express had carried a front-page report about the crowds. However, a fact-check revealed a different story. While one image was AI-generated, an old rally video was shared with a misleading date, and the alleged appeal by Kareena Kapoor turned out to be fake. Watch this report to find out the truth behind these viral claims.
Video Editor: Satyam
